officialText:
Section 408.60 – Add a new Section 408.60 to Part IV to read as follows:

408.60 Freestanding Switchboards and Switchgear. Freestanding switchboards and switchgear, which require rear access, shall have hinged rear doors fastened by captive screws or suitable latches. Freestanding switchboards and switchgear, which do not require rear access, shall have non-removable rear covers.
